summary: Validated Propto Taxonomy v3.2 pipeline end-to-end. Ran both taxonomy probes (taxonomy_v3_probe.py=171/172 as expected, issue_keyword_probe.py=FAILURES: 0). Added /app/backend/tests/test_taxonomy_v3_integration.py (9 pytest cases, all PASS) exercising the simulate webhook: Plumbing & Leakage ticket with sub_category='Tap leak', routing_category='Plumbing', issue_id and location='Flat'; Electrical Critical for 'no power'; Water Supply routing with Plumbing vendor fallback check; status/activity phrases ('working on it rn','on my way','swimming pool issue is resolved') produce NO ticket; GET /api/society/tickets?category=Plumbing returns v3 tickets whose routing_category=Plumbing combined with search; vendors still carry the 11 old categories. Frontend verified on preview URL: /tickets page loads for society admin, the 11 old category filter pills render ('All, Plumbing, Electrical, Lift, Security, Housekeeping, Civil, Parking, Gardening, Water Supply, DG Set, Pest Control'), Plumbing filter lists plumbing tickets, Water Supply filter lists Water Supply (v3) tickets, detail sheet shows Category and Issue (sub_category) rows (Location row only renders if location is set; new v3 ticket has location='Flat' which backend confirmed), vendor assign dropdown orders matching-routing-category vendors first (AquaFix Plumbing shown without the '(other)' suffix for both Plumbing and Water Supply tickets).
critical_code_review_comments: society_router.list_tickets: when both category and search are supplied, category uses $and-$or while search sets q['$or'] separately — this coexists correctly but is fragile; combining them inside the same $and would be more defensive.

pipeline.create_ticket: Water Supply vendor fallback is hard-coded. Consider generalising via taxonomy_v3.VENDOR_CATEGORY fallback chain so new v3 → old-vendor fallbacks are driven by data, not conditionals.

Tickets.jsx detail sheet renders Issue/Location rows only when sub_category/location are truthy; for older tickets both are empty, which is correct but worth documenting so users don't think the UI dropped them.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates ~3 TEST-<uuid>-prefixed tickets and the module teardown fixture deletes them via pymongo. Verified post-run no stale TEST tickets remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_taxonomy_v3_integration.py uses /api/society/whatsapp/simulate with resident phone 918111111101 (A101) on Green Valley Residency. Runs serial via `-n 0` (pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2 by default). Each message is TAG-prefixed to avoid dedupe hits across runs. taxonomy_v3_probe.py expected to show 171/172 (one known miss: 'Maid ID card not issued' → Security & Gate vs Staff & Domestic Help).
